verified: Reuters, citing unnamed sources, reported that the administration is weighing a requirement for US companies to disclose Chinese AI model use on their websites, with the aim of discouraging that use.
unconfirmed: Whether any rule will be proposed or finalized, which agency would write or enforce it, when it might take effect, what counts as a Chinese model, and whether disclosure would be mandatory or voluntary — all of this rests on unnamed sources and no official document.

verified: 路透社报道称，据未具名消息人士说法，特朗普政府正在考虑要求美国企业在其网站披露使用中国 AI 模型的情况，以劝阻采用。
unconfirmed: 政府是否已作出决定或形成正式提案、具体覆盖范围和执行机构、违规后果及时间表；目前没有官方确认。

titles.en: White House weighs requiring US firms to disclose Chinese AI use, Reuters reports
titles.zh: 特朗普政府据报考虑要求美企披露中国AI模型使用，路透社报道
